notes: Each pair differs only in profile and configured barcode presence in its frozen identity. Index, catalogue, lookup, query, config and source fingerprints match.
All rows remain in the fixed positive or negative denominator. Zero error and degraded rows occur in these completed runs.
A saved http_status=200 is a bulk result field, not an actual HTTP recognition measurement.
All seven barcode runs record cached=true on every barcode step. Native ZXing call counts are not recorded.
Barcode cache hits do not imply a unique catalogue answer. Codes on unmatched or ambiguous rows continue to retrieval.
A barcode unique return has a one-candidate answer and no retrieval trace.
An allowed negative prediction is not a confirmed correct identification.
All profiles use four workers and use_cache=true. Equal settings do not establish equal cache state.
Runner wall is cached bulk elapsed time. It does not measure fresh sequential HTTP recognition or prove a three-second deadline.

The p1024 index has 4181 current items and 2096 full / 2092 label wines; p256/p512 have 4054 current items and 2051 full / 2047 label wines. Cross-budget effects therefore include coverage differences.
unique_wine_returns counts query rows that resolve to one wine. It does not count distinct wine identities.
